title: Pure Roid
summary: Syrus Truesdale's Vehicroid and non-WIND Machine roid build, with generic Machine support and staples. Megaroid City, Mixeroid, and Dragonroid search and summon Expressroid and Ambulanceroid, while Vehicroid Connection Zone and Mixeroid's GY effect bring out the Super Vehicroid Fusion bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Megaroid City destroys another card you control to add any roid card from your Deck to your hand, including Mixeroid, Vehicroid Connection Zone, or Emergeroid Call.
Mixeroid Tributes any Machine monster to Special Summon a non-WIND roid monster directly from the Deck.
Dragonroid discards itself to search any non-WIND roid monster or prevent your Fusion Summons and their activations from being negated that turn.
Expressroid adds two roid monsters from your GY to your hand when Summoned, which immediately triggers Ambulanceroid to Special Summon them to the field.

summary.title: Opening: Megaroid City + Mixeroid
steps: Normal Summon Mixeroid and Tribute it to Special Summon Ambulanceroid or Expressroid from your Deck.
Activate Megaroid City to destroy a card you control and search Vehicroid Connection Zone or Emergeroid Call.

Banish Mixeroid and Machine monsters from your GY to pay half your LP and Special Summon Super Vehicroid - Mobile Base from the Extra Deck, or activate Vehicroid Connection Zone to Fusion Summon Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union or Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill.

summary.title: Megaroid City Stat Swap
summary.text: During damage calculation, Megaroid City can send a roid monster from your Deck to the GY to switch the original ATK and DEF of your battling monster. That turns Super Vehicroid - Mobile Base (0 ATK / 5000 DEF) into a 5000 ATK attacker while dumping Expressroid or Fusion materials into the GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union (3600 ATK) and Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill (3000 ATK) become indestructible by card effects and cannot have their effects negated when Fusion Summoned via Vehicroid Connection Zone.
Super Vehicroid - Mobile Base targets a face-up monster the opponent controls to Special Summon a roid from your Deck or Extra Deck, and returns a roid on your field to the hand during the End Phase.
Barbaroid, the Ultimate Battle Machine (4000 ATK) attacks twice per Battle Phase, negates the effects of monsters it battles, and burns for 1000 on battle destruction.
Gear Gigant X and Platinum Gadget extend Rank 4 and Link-2 Machine plays.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Instant Fusion pays 1000 LP to Special Summon Level 5 Pair Cycroid directly from the Extra Deck, turning on Emergeroid Call immediately.

Emergeroid Call negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a roid Fusion Monster and sends all cards with that name from the opponent's Deck and Extra Deck to the GY, then banishes itself from the GY to recover a roid.
Supercharge draws two cards when your opponent declares an attack while all monsters you control are Machine roid monsters.

allow.Instant Fusion: Limited to 1 in TCG: pays 1000 LP to Special Summon Level 5 EARTH Machine Fusion Pair Cycroid directly from your Extra Deck—which can attack directly for 1600 damage AND fulfills the '1 "roid" Fusion Monster' requirement on the field to activate Counter Trap Emergeroid Call!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the essential Megaroid City Field Spell.
allow.Supercharge: Syrus's signature Normal Trap: when your opponent declares an attack while the only monsters you control are Machine 'roid' monsters, draws 2 cards!
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 roid from your hand.
allow.Gear Gigant X: Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz made with two Level 4 roids that detaches 1 material to search Mixeroid, Expressroid, or Ambulanceroid.

main: Mixeroid

Core Level 4 WIND Machine starter: tributes 1 Machine monster to Special Summon any non-WIND 'roid' monster directly from your Deck; and banishes itself + Machines from GY to cheat out a 'roid' Fusion Monster from Extra Deck!
Dragonroid

Core Level 8 WIND Machine searcher (2900 ATK): discards itself from hand to add ANY non-WIND 'roid' monster from Deck to hand OR prevent Fusion Summons from being negated this turn; becomes Dragon in GY.
Expressroid
Core Level 4 EARTH Machine recursion engine: when Summoned, targets 2 'roid' monsters in your GY and adds both to your hand—immediately triggering Ambulanceroid if on field!
Ambulanceroid
Level 3 EARTH Machine swarm engine: whenever a 'roid' monster(s) is added from your GY to your hand (by Expressroid or Emergeroid Call!), immediately Special Summons that monster(s)!
Truckroid
Level 4 EARTH Machine (1000 ATK / 2000 DEF -> 2000 ATK when swapped by Megaroid City!): equips any opponent's monster it destroys by battle to itself; named material for Stealth Union!
Drillroid
Level 4 EARTH Machine: automatically destroys any Defense Position monster it attacks before damage calculation; named material for Stealth Union and Jumbo Drill!
Steamroid
Level 4 EARTH Machine (1800 ATK -> 2300 ATK when attacking): named Fusion Material for Stealth Union and Jumbo Drill.
Submarineroid
Level 4 WATER Machine: can attack directly (swaps to 1800 ATK via Megaroid City!) and switches to Defense Position at the end of Battle Phase; named material for Stealth Union and Jumbo Drill!
Gyroid
Level 3 WIND Machine that cannot be destroyed by battle once per turn.
Megaroid City

Core Field Spell: destroys 1 card you control to add ANY 'roid' card from Deck to hand; and swaps battling 'roid' monster's original ATK and DEF (turning 0 ATK / 5000 DEF Mobile Base into a 5000 ATK attacker)!
Vehicroid Connection Zone
Signature Fusion Spell: Fusion Summons 1 'Vehicroid' Fusion Monster from Extra Deck—and the summoned monster CANNOT be destroyed by card effects, and its effects CANNOT be negated!
Instant Fusion
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 5 Pair Cycroid from your Extra Deck, immediately turning on Emergeroid Call!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Megaroid City.
Emergeroid Call

Signature Counter Trap: while you control a 'roid' Fusion Monster, negates an activation and sends all cards with that name from opponent's Deck/Extra Deck to GY; banishes from GY to add a roid from GY to hand!
Supercharge
Draws 2 cards when an opponent declares an attack while all monsters you control are Machine 'roid' monsters.
extra: Signature Level 10 EARTH Machine Fusion boss (0 ATK / 5000 DEF): Special Summons 1 'roid' from Deck/Extra Deck, and steals an opponent's monster; reaches 5000 ATK when swapped by Megaroid City!
Level 12 EARTH Machine Fusion boss (4000 ATK): attacks twice per Battle Phase, negates effects of monsters it battles, and burns for 1000 on battle destruction!
Signature Level 9 EARTH Machine Fusion boss (3600 ATK): equips 1 non-Machine monster once per turn to attack ALL monsters your opponent controls, with piercing!
Signature Level 8 EARTH Machine Fusion boss (3000 ATK): inflicts piercing battle damage, and becomes indestructible by card effects when summoned via Vehicroid Connection Zone!
Level 5 EARTH Machine Fusion: can attack directly for 1600 damage and turns on Emergeroid Call!
Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz that searches any Level 4 or lower Machine roid.
Link-2 Machine that summons a Level 4 roid from your hand.
